decisions.decision: All living patients, including children, unless the request explicitly limits age.
Attribute costs to enrollment coverage active in the service month.
Include visits from living patients only in both numerator and denominator, unless deceased patients are explicitly requested.

Use eligible insurer claims for payer/VBC contract reports; use all received deduplicated medical claims for clinical utilization; return both labeled counts when report context is unclear. Never sum the overlapping readings.
decisions.human_answer: Use report context; show both if unclear

decisions.decision: Counts, volumes, rates and shares of EVENTS (admissions, ED visits, stays, fills, appointments, no-shows, discharges) include every patient who had them; the living rule applies to counts and lists of patients. Supersedes frequent_ed_volume_denominator.
decisions.human_answer: Everyone, everywhere (asked twice, conflict with frequent_ed_volume_denominator resolved by Mike in the build-owner conversation, evening)

decisions.decision: 'Hospital stay', 'admission' and 'hospitalization' = inpatient OR observation; 'inpatient' alone = inpatient only.
Pharmacy spend = net payer spend over all pharmacy claim transactions, reversals and recoupments netted (pharmacy_claim_event.payer_paid_delta_cents by event_date).
Medical spend and cost per claim = payer paid amount on counted medical claims (payer_claim.counts_in_metrics = 1) by service date.
